reviews.text:
I would like to thank Dr. Forsans for his professionalism and the excellent care he provided for my two kittens.

He is an experienced, courteous, pleasant, and very dedicated veterinarian who listens attentively and takes the necessary time to provide care with seriousness, efficiency, and great respect for the animal.

He performed the neutering of my two kittens, as well as various maintenance treatments, and everything went perfectly. I particularly appreciated the fact that he personally handled all aspects of their care, which fosters a genuine relationship of trust and personalized follow-up.

A very positive experience, which naturally leads me to keep him as my primary veterinarian for my animals.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Forsans, both for his expertise and his compassionate nature. A trustworthy veterinarian, the kind we wish we could find more often!
A very professional veterinarian, takes good care of your pet and takes the time to inform you.

I wanted to sincerely thank you for healing my Jun. I was very worried when I first came to see you. It's been three and a half years since you treated her, and I've never been disappointed. Your professionalism, responsiveness, and kindness made all the difference during that difficult time. Thanks to you, she's doing much better. Thank you so much for your exceptional work and dedication to animals. 😊

A vet who truly loves animals and takes good care of them. I've been bringing my cat to him for two years, and he's always taken the time to answer my questions. He's a very reassuring vet, and the cost of consultations and surgeries is quite reasonable.

Dr. Forsans has been treating our animals for many years. He takes our pets' problems very seriously. Right now, he's helping us through the difficult transition of our 17-year-old dog's old age, as she has significant cognitive problems.

A vet in decline.
He's only capable of giving vaccinations, and even then he hurt my kitten.
He couldn't even identify his extremely dangerous and potentially fatal feline herpesvirus.
He just gave him eye ointment.
He doesn't even write his name in his medical record.
The appointment lasts a maximum of 10 minutes, and he doesn't appreciate many questions. He's very vague or gives monologues unrelated to my cats.
Appalling.
He'd be better off retiring quickly and making way for a young, fresh vet. He's only good at taking money and nothing else.
Extremely disappointed and completely out of touch.
Excellent veterinarian who loves animals very much.
Excellent vet, simple, efficient and very friendly!

I am absolutely satisfied with Dr. Forsans' services. The veterinarian is incredibly kind and always takes the time needed to care for my cat. You can feel his genuine passion and high level of professionalism. I recommend him 100%!

No attention was paid to the cat. We told him he was vomiting, and he said it was normal. My 8-year-old cat, seen at another vet, has a tumor from his tongue to his larynx. This vet is incompetent and should be avoided at all costs.

The doctor is efficient and gives good advice, and I don't understand the opposing opinions of some. I think people confuse work and affection, meaning you take your pet to the vet for a vaccination, treatment, a problem, or a question, but not to be psychoanalyzed 🤣🤣🤣, stroked the right way 🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣, or to have a drink 🤣🤣🤣🤣🤣. So, if the cat or dog is doing well, if the vaccination is done, then that's great... the vet isn't a psychologist or a psychiatrist. As for mood, who's in a constant mood all the time? The vet has the same rights as everyone else. For my part, I have a positive opinion; I'm delighted and will take my four cats here. Finally, spelling is something you work on throughout your life, and well-spelled conversations seem more credible to me 🤣🤣🤣🤣🥹Samantha Moran Pauget

I was extremely surprised to see so many positive reviews after my visit. The doctor wasn't paying any attention to my cat, who was on the table, and preferred to tell us his life story, completely irrelevant to the topic at hand, rather than answering my questions clearly. The few answers I managed to get, after many fierce battles to refocus him on the subject, were based on his own experiences rather than objective facts. As a result, I consulted another veterinarian, who helped me separate fact from fiction after that disastrous previous visit.

Dr. Forsans was very kind and extremely patient with us and our cat, despite our difficulties getting him to his appointment on time 😅
He reassured us and answered all our questions. His prices were much more reasonable than what we had estimated based on Google. Thank you! 🐈‍⬛ …

We brought home a kitten we found in the street 15 days ago. He's quite sociable, as we have to put drops in his eyes five times a day and give him medication in his mouth. This vet couldn't even manage to draw blood! …
I am very satisfied, a very professional, competent and friendly specialist, and local, he has always taken good care of my cat, his explanations are always clear and simple, I highly recommend him.
